programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: As an animal filmmaker, one often deals with lots of strange old birds. No wonder, that so much can go wrong. After a long day of filming, a surprise awaits at the camp: Wolves have been looking for chocolate biscuits! Yet these are not the only things that can happen in the Arctic. Yann Sochaczewski is out and about in the magnificent Grand Canyon. On his raft on the Colorado River, he risks life and limb in doing so. In Australia, Thoralf Grospitz and Jens Westphalen play cat and mouse with an odd bird, that turns out to be a real entertainer. In the Serengeti, Reinhard Radke despairs of the many tourists who constantly walk in front of his lens. Wildlife filmmakers travel around the world for these very encounters. They bring nature into our living rooms, experience the beautiful, the saddest and the most poignant moments. And many funny ones.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: When humans and wild animals live next door to one another, things can sometimes be a little hairy. Some organise themselves in impertinent gangs, others mutually cultivate their own friendships. In New Zealand, keas organise themselves into gangs and obviously have it in for all the rubber seals belonging to winter sports enthusiasts. Their motto: nibble all you can. In Australia, Klaus Weißmann and Rolf Sziringer struggle with a huge invasion. Thousands of flies have taken a liking to the two men. This causes frayed nerves. And in Zambia, Jens Westphalen and Thoralf Grospitz capture a veritable display of elephants with the camera. Every year, their fine noses lead them into a hotel garden - in which the fruits on the wild mango tree are ripe. But, there is a catch: To get to their picnic, they have to walk through the lobby. This is what happens when buildings are erected around even older premises.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: In accordance with the seasons and with deep respect of nature, people all over the world celebrate their long-standing traditions. Near the outermost border of Europe, in Bashkiria, generations of bee keepers have collected honey from rare wild bees, the Burzyan bees. In Japan the last of the Usho catch fish with "living fishing rods": trained cormorants. Traditionally, they provided the Emperor's family with fresh fish. In Poland carp are fished from the ponds to provide everybody with carp for Christmas dinner - this is an old Polish tradition. In Frisia winter is driven out by fires at what is known as "Biikebrennen", and in Hungary the "Busho" - frightening characters wearing wooden masks - do a similar job. "Four seasons - Many traditions" is a journey, meeting people who are passionate at keeping old traditions alive.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: Wild Moments: Four Seasons - Spring & Summer
programme.desc: In accordance with the seasons and with deep respect of nature, people all over the world celebrate their long-standing traditions. In Japan the first picnics at the cherry blossom festival kick off the long-awaited outdoor season, while the Scots perform their Highland Games. In the summer the Latvians celebrate the biggest party of the year: midsummer night. The vast wildflower meadows provide them with wreathes of flowers which have magical healing powers; animals are provided with an abundance of insects. This enables the rare hoopoe to breed in Latvia. In the Spree forest region, an enchanting river landscape south-east of Berlin, farmers still harvest the famous Spreeforest Cucumber. "Four seasons - Many traditions" is a visual journey around the globe meeting people who are passionate and dedicated at keeping old traditions alive.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Wild Holland - The Living Delta
programme.desc: The film celebrates the diverse natural heritage of the Dutch delta region while sketching the cultural context that has played such a vital part in shaping it. Using cutting edge cinematic techniques ranging from eagle’s eye aerial views to unprecedented underwater scenes, 'Wild Holland - The Living Delta' presents a portrait of this unique wetland area of Europe as never seen before, capturing it in an important moment of change - a time when new life is flooding back into the delta.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild & Wide Awake - From the Mediterranean to the Alps
programme.desc: The first part of the spring journey takes us from the Spanish inland to the rugged Atlantic and to the Mediterranean, through the French Provence, and finally into the Alps. Along the way, flamingos perform their bizarre dancing rituals, wild horses storm through the wetland… While the North is still covered by snow and ice, the South will soon turn into a blooming garden and every creature is enjoying the first signs of the awakening.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is a road of mountain passes and India’s access to the roof of the world – the Himalayas. This 475-kilometre long route at the northernmost tip of the Indian subcontinent connects the cities of Manali and Leh at the heart of the Ladakh region. The term “highway” applies quite literally, since the route traverses five of the highest drivable mountain passes in the world – among these the Lohtang La at 3,978 metres above sea level, the Lachulung La at 5,059 metres and the Tanglang La at 5,325 metres. Crossing these passes is a challenge for both vehicle and man. The mountain peaks, still snow-capped even in the depths of summer, wide variety of vegetation and the fantastic and craggy landscape turn any journey into a captivating adventure.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia; only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The air wants to flee the heat, but is too weak. It hovers just above the ground, heavy and weighed down by the oven-like heat. It turns wanly around itself, and tries to cool off by liquefying itself. It vibrates, it oscillates – but there is no escape. This is West Africa in late March. The Harmattan, the hot desert wind of the Sahara, is blowing without respite. It has no pity with the people who live here. Whoever wants to go from one place to another has to travel on roads that hardly deserve this name. They are dusty paths that don’t appear on any map. They are maneuverable only with great effort and for a few months of the year. They are impassable during the rainy season, since they are washed over by the Niger River, one of the mightiest rivers in the world. When it starts to rain, the roads turn into muddy paths. Every journey is a trip into uncertainty.

They are maneuverable only with great effort and for a few months of the year. They are impassable during the rainy season, since they are washed over by the Niger River, one of the mightiest rivers in the world. When it starts to rain, the roads turn into muddy paths. Every journey is a trip into uncertainty.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. The landscapes through which these routes wind are unique and exert their never-ending fascination even on regular travellers. In our documentary “Hot Roads – An Icebound Road” which is part of the five-part film series “Hot Roads” we want to tell the stories that take place along the route itself, of the people who live along it and for whom the road is part and parcel of their personal destiny.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

Knochenjobs
programme.desc: In einer Hamburger Werft liegt eine Hafenfähre zur Modernisierung. Das Schiff wurde dafür komplett entkernt. Ein halbes Jahr soll die Fähre in der Werft bleiben, dann soll sie wieder auf die Elbe. Schiffsbauer Melvin Ommer und Torben Groth bauen die generalüberholte Antriebsmaschine wieder ein. Gar nicht so einfach, denn das riesige Bauteil wiegt 1,5 Tonnen, und der Maschinenraum ist eng.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Ein Hotel in Rheinland-Pfalz hat einen besonders extravaganten Anbau in Auftrag gegeben. Ein Baumhaus auf Stelzen soll als neuer Konferenzraum dienen. Zimmerer, Dachdecker und Fensterbauer arbeiten auf engem Raum zusammen, um das klobige Holzhaus zu montieren. Die Bauteile sind schwer und die Männer arbeiten am Hang. Große Maschinen können sie deshalb kaum einsetzen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: LKW-Pannenhelfer Stephan Lommatzsch bekommt einen seltenen Auftrag: Auf einer Schnellstraße ist ein Bagger beim Verladen auf den LKW umgekippt. Und solange das Fahrzeug auf der Straße liegt, muss die Straße gesperrt bleiben. Lommatzsch muss bei der Bergung sorgfältig arbeiten, und darf sich weder von genervten Autofahrern noch vom gestressten Chef der Baufirma aus der Ruhe bringen lassen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Baustellen verlangen Arbeitern viel ab – besonders wenn es um Hochhäuser geht.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse soll ein achtzigjähriger Ford ein paar PS zulegen, während die Porsche-Experten von 9elf einen äußerst seltenen Carrera 3.0 auf dem Weg zur erfolgreichen Hauptuntersuchung betreuen. Bei Il Motore steht ein Kellerfund vor der Entkernung: neuer Motor für einen alten Fiat 500. Eine top erhaltene DDR-Simson S50 findet ihren Weg zu den Spezialisten der Flying Classics.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Der Name ist Programm: Bei Il Motore dreht sich fast alles um Antriebsmaschinen. Minustemperaturen für die luftgekühlte Rarität von 9elf: Eisstrahlung beim Carrera 3.0. In der Halle der Flying Classics wartet ein schick überholtes Kultmoped auf die Abholung. Für eine Handvoll PS mehr muss sich der betagte Ford in Tom's Roadhouse von seinem Getriebe verabschieden.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Korrosion mit Coolnessfaktor: Auf dem Hof der Flying Classics landet eine Simson Schwalbe im Rost-Design. Die Porsche-Experten von 9elf verpassen dem frisch gestrahlten Carrera ein komplettes Check-up. In der Werkstatt von Il Motore wirkt strahlender Sand wahre Wunder. Motortausch für eine amerikanische Legende: In Tom's Roadhouse wartet ein Mustang auf seine neue Maschine.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Für den Carrera schlägt die Stunde der Wahrheit. Wird das edle Sammlerstück dem kritischen Prüfer-Blick standhalten? Der Il Motore-Chef jagt einen asiatischen Kultflitzer Marke Datsun auf den Leistungsstand. Geduldsprobe für den Vespa-Experten: Die Kupplung einer alten spanischen Vespa wird zum Problemfall. Auch die Montage des neuen Mustang-Motors wird zur kniffligen Herausforderung.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Nichts kann eine Schlammlawine aufhalten. Einmal ausgelöst, walzt sie erbarmungslos alles nieder. Drei Schlammlawinen in Kalifornien, Venezuela und Wales haben in der jüngeren Geschichte besonderes Entsetzen hervorgerufen, als sie teilweise ganze Landstriche unter sich begruben.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Die Pandemie ist der unsichtbare Killer: Eine verheerende Krankheitswelle, die um den ganzen Globus wandert, wird angesichts der Bevölkerungsentwicklung immer wahrscheinlicher. So unterschiedliche Krankheiten wie Ebola und die Schweinepest zeigen, dass jeder Kontinent unvermittelt betroffen sein kann. Gesundheitsexperten sind überzeugt, dass das Risiko für eine weltumspannende Epidemie steigt.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Neben Hungersnöten zählen Flutkatastrophen zu den humanitären Krisen mit den meisten Opfern der Geschichte. Eindrucksvolle Bilder zeigen die Ursachen anhand einiger der größten Überschwemmungen in jüngerer Zeit: Am Mississippi in den USA, an der Elbe in Deutschland und in New York City entfaltete sich die unaufhaltsame Gewalt großer Wassermassen.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Vulkane regen seit jeher unsere Fantasie an. Der tragische Untergang des römischen Pompeji übt bis heute eine morbide Faszination aus. Die Vorstellung schmelzenden Gesteins in feurigen Explosionen schürt Urängste und Alpträume. Vom italienischen Vesuv bis zum Kilauea auf Hawaii - schlafende und aktive Vulkane stellen eine immerwährende Bedrohung dar.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: TCC 78000 ist einer der leistungsstärksten landgebundenen Schwerlastkrane.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Der Puma gilt als modernster Schützenpanzer der Welt, steht aber in der Kritik.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Deutschlands älteste Berufsfeuerwehr arbeitet am Limit. Besonders betroffen: der Stadtteil Neukölln. Mehr als 2000 Mal im Monat rücken hier die Retter vom Dienst aus. Die Menschen greifen immer schneller zum Hörer und wählen 112, auch wenn‘s nicht wirklich brennt. Die Arbeit im rauen Bezirk im Zentrum Berlins gilt als besonders fordernd und spannend und zieht deshalb vor allem Feuerwehrleute an.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Die Neuköllner Feuerwehrleute werden zu einem Motorrad-Unfall gerufen. Vor Ort wartet bereits eine Menschenmenge aus ebenso unbeteiligten, wie störenden Zuschauern. Gaffen aus Sensationslust und Respektlosigkeit gegenüber den Rettern ist in Neukölln ein wachsendes Problem. Stress ohne Ende - wenn die Arbeit der Feuerwehr zum Hindernislauf wird.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Ein selbstmordgefährdeter Mann, eine Wohnung unter Wasser und ein Mann mit Verfolgungswahn. Neukölln gehört zu Berlins ärmsten Bezirken. Die Auswirkungen beschäftigen auch die Männer von der Feuerwehr rund um die Uhr. In einem Fall müssen die Retter sogar mehrmals ausrücken: Ein Obdachloser will partout nicht ins Krankenhaus. Einsatz in Neukölln - wenn die Armut krankmacht.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Diesmal hält ein Wohnungsbrand in der Sonnenallee die Männer der Feuerwache Neukölln in Atem. Kaum angekommen, wird ihnen klar: Es sind noch Menschen in dem brennenden Haus. Die Wohnungen sind aber schwer zu erreichen. Jetzt wird allen alles abverlangt. Es bleibt jedoch nicht bei diesem Großeinsatz in ihrer Schicht.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Neun Autos stehen in einem Neuköllner Hinterhof in Flammen - ein Einsatz, auch für erfahrene Feuerwehrmänner nicht alltäglich. War es Brandstiftung? Eine andere Herausforderung für die Truppe ist der Notruf aus einer Laubenkolonie: Ein Mann mit Herzinfarkt. Es geht um Leben und Tod.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Das Team 9elf steigt um. Statt mit Porsche geben die PS-Experten im VW-Beetle Gas auf der Rennstrecke. Ein betagter Italiener muss sich beweisen. Läuft der bei Il Motore überholte Fiat-Motor problemlos? In Tom’s Roadhouse bekommt das Ford-Hot Rod seine Achsen zurück. Wird die Problem-Kupplung der spanischen Vespa nach furioser Feinarbeit der Flying Classics wieder funktionieren?

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Beim Team 9elf treffen die langersehnten Edel-Felgen ein. Die Flying Classics bringen eine blaue Schwalbe auf Vordermann. Die Fachkenntnis des Il Motore-Teams ist ausnahmsweise bei einem Flugzeug-Oldie gefragt. Auch der Ford aus den 30er Jahren steht bei Tom's Roadhouse vor einer speziellen Premiere: Jungfernfahrt mit einem Gang mehr.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Ein Traumcabrio wartet bei Il Motore auf seine Motorrevision. Der Cadillac DeVille bringt die Fans von edlen Classic Cars zum Schwärmen. Das Team 9elf muss einen Porsche mit gestopften Rostlöchern durch die GTÜ-Prüfung bekommen. Außeneinsätze für die blaue Schwalbe bei den Flying Classics und den Mustang aus Tom's Roadhouse. Sind die Werkstatt-Eingriffe gut verlaufen?

programme.title: Vulkanismus in Deutschland
programme.desc: Der Geysir von Andernach ist mit über 60 Meter Höhe DIE Attraktion der Osteifel.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Länder wie Saudi-Arabien sind an Hitze über 40 Grad Celsius gewöhnt. Doch als 2010 eine Hitzewelle mit ähnlichen Temperaturen über Russland hereinbrach, starben geschätzt 56.000 Menschen. Und der europäische Supersommer 2003 hinterließ rund 70.000 Todesopfer. Außergewöhnliches Bildmaterial und Klimaspezialisten gewähren einen Einblick in die genauen Zusammenhänge der beiden Hitzekatastrophen.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Klirrende Kälte und beinharte Windböen kennzeichnen den Blizzard. Die Winterstürme sind Tötungsmaschinen der Natur. Sie bringen oft riesige Mengen Schnee - aber nicht immer, wie Wetterexperten erläutern. Am Beispiel zweier Blizzards an Nordamerikas Atlantikküste zeigen sie, welche Formen extreme Kälteeinbrüche annehmen können.

programme.title: Emergency Room Essen
programme.desc: Im größten Krankenhaus des Ruhrgebiets herrscht fast immer Ausnahmezustand. 24 Stunden täglich, an 365 Tagen im Jahr. Pausen gibt es für die Ärzte während ihrer langen Schichten kaum, auch weil immer häufiger Menschen mit kleinen Wehwehchen zu ihnen kommen. Sie wollen die Wartezeiten bei ihren Hausärzten umgehen. Die Folge: Mediziner und Pfleger sind am Limit.

programme.title: Emergency Room Essen
programme.desc: Wenn am Wochenende die Hausarztpraxen geschlossen sind, geht es hoch her in der Notaufnahme des Uniklinikums Essen. Patienten mit Verdacht auf Herzinfarkt, Schlaganfall oder andere lebensbedrohliche Krankheiten, werden sofort behandelt. Doch wer mit Husten, Schnupfen, Heiserkeit oder sonstigen Lappalien kommt, muss sich erstmal hintenanstellen. Wartezeit: manchmal über sieben Stunden.

programme.title: Berufsgeheimnisse
programme.desc: Für Neurochirurg Prof. Peter Vajkoczy steht eine komplizierte Operation an: eine Patientin mit einem Hypophysentumor. Beim Eingriff wendet der Hirnspezialist eine besondere Methode an. Er operiert durch die Nase der Patientin und vermeidet damit eine Öffnung des Schädels. Navena Widulin hütet den medizinhistorischen Schatz der Charité: die Präparatesammlung.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E09 - Purpose Of Life (Part 2)
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

programme.desc: Marilia’s journey on South Africa's Garden Route explores plant medicine, beauty in nature, and animal communication, emphasizing the profound connection between humans and the natural world.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E06 - Cape Town
programme.desc: In Cape Town, the journey unfolds, connecting with mentors, experiencing creative breakthroughs, spiritual rituals, and ancestral connections. From this transformative experience, Marilia discovers the power of inner strength and connection.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E07 - Cornwall NB
programme.desc: In this episode, Marilia explores various locations in Cornwall. She visits Boscastle, known for its witch stories, and enjoys ocean views from a field. She also explores Merlin's Cave and meets a life coach named Euan in St Neot. Marilia engages in nature bathing and encounters wildlife while walking towards Muir. At Joe's home and studio, she assists him in painting and enjoys his vinyl covers and guitar music. Marilia learns about animal massage therapy from Jenna and goes on a carriage ride through rural scenery. She joins the Seaweeders for seaweed foraging, visits the drying warehouse, and meets Gemma, an Alexander Technique specialist. Marilia also takes time to relax at a hotel spa, filming her show against the stunning ocean cliff. This episode offers a captivating exploration of Cornwall's landscapes, encounters with talented individuals, and immersive experiences.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E08 - St. Pete NB
programme.desc: Marilia embarks on a captivating journey, capturing the essence of Treasure Island through extraordinary encounters. They film hidden treasures and enchanting allure against stunning backdrops. At Fort DeSoto, Marilia embraces the tranquil beauty of the beach, while Ashley leads them to Boyd Hill National Park for profound conversations beneath a magnificent tree. In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The crew are headed to a place they never thought they would ever see in their lifetime - Antarctica. Claimed by some, owned by no one. A continent for peace and science, the betterment of all mankind. Scott and Justin are granted a rare opportunity to stay in the Chilean scientific base on King George Island. They spend a week learning about life on the continent, while visiting the nearby Russian and China bases, all perfect microcosms of their home countries. The three then get on a Russian expedition ship and head down the Antarctic peninsula to witness some of the world’s most breathtaking and serene atmospheres imaginable. They discover all the wonderful flora and fauna of Antarctica, and end it all by claiming a little piece of Antarctica for themselves in Paradise Bay, and building a snowman to guard their claim.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E01 - Russia - Comrades And Capitals
programme.desc: Anything is possible in Russia. Scott and Justin meet up with their friend Bogdan and visit the last man living in the radioactive zone in Chernobyl. They visit St. Petersburg for some homemade vodka and to celebrate Bogdan’s birthday, before hopping on an overnight train to Moscow. The adventures in Moscow are diverse: An awkward visit to a Russian bath, a wild night out in an exhilarating dance club and a chance to drive a cold-war military tank. Next, they fly to Siberia and meet a vodka-slamming shaman, who puts them all to shame on the dance floor.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest
programme.sub-title: My Pacific Quest S01 E06 - Kiribati NB
programme.desc: For thousands of years, the island peoples of the Pacific were masters of the ocean, sailing across the waves in handmade canoes and navigating by the stars. But, these traditional ways and sailing knowledge are being lost to technology. Host Ellis Emmett helps get a traditional canoe back on the water, and sees first-hand how rising seas are changing life in the island chains of Kiribati.

programme.desc: Um guardacostas é encarregado de proteger a filha de um importante cientista, para que a pesquisa de sua empresa não caia em mãos erradas. Quando um grupo de mercenários surge para roubar o material, será preciso lutar para sobreviver.

programme.title: A Colônia
programme.desc: Na nova era glacial, um grupo de sobreviventes luta para proteger a humanidade de uma ameaça muito mais selvagem do que a natureza.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo avança com seus planos para assumir o controle da empresa ao lado de Rodrigo, que já tem um escritório nos laboratórios. Jimena decide organizar um jantar com os acionistas na mansão Ferrándiz para mostrar que tudo está sob controle. Julio e Leo voltam a brigar na frente de María Lucía. Alejandra faz Oriana acreditar que o resultado do exame é positivo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: O banquete para os acionistas acontece na mansão Ferrándiz. Além dos executivos, María Lucía e Sandra também comparecem, querendo contar a Irene e Trinidad as novidades sobre a falsa enfermeira. Quando María Lucía revela a verdade a Trinidad, as duas são trancadas no quarto por Carlota, que se recusa a deixá-las sair.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Depois que a reunião na mansão fracassa, Jimena confronta Agustina e Adolfo. Leo decide sair de casa e Leonardo, abatido, cancela a reunião com os acionistas. Irene reafirma seu apoio incondicional ao marido. No dia seguinte, Jimena tenta resolver as coisas com seus contatos. Irene confronta Alejandra sobre o caso da enfermeira falsa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto sofre uma crise e Leo está lá para ajudá-lo. Ele é levado ao hospital com urgência. Leo tenta conversar com o pai, mas Leonardo não o ouve. Leo consegue falar com Jimena, que vai até a clínica. Agustina finge ter algo importante a tratar com Adolfo e marca uma reunião na empresa por sugestão de Jimena. Em um momento de distração, Agustina rouba um tablet dele.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto continua hospitalizado. Leo e seu pai se reconciliam. Julio chega e a tensão entre os irmãos é evidente. Virginia confessa a Felipe o conteúdo das cartas de Miguel Ferrándiz: há um filho de Rebeca que não é de Leonardo. Oriana recebe o envelope com o teste de gravidez de Alejandra, e Maribel conta a Irene que a advogada está ajudando a garota.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo e seu filho esclarecem o boato sobre o suposto romance com Alejandra. Enquanto isso, Adolfo procura desesperadamente por seu tablet, primeiro pressionando Tony e depois indo até a mansão Ferrándiz para interrogar Agustina. Martín, o assistente de Felipe, promete a Rodrigo que conseguirá os documentos secretos de Miguel Ferrándiz.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo continua trancado com Irene no elevador e segue com seu jogo macabro de insinuações para desestabilizá-la. Toda a família procura por Irene desesperadamente. Leonardo liga para ela sem parar, sem sucesso. O mesmo acontece com suas irmãs e mãe. Agustina sugere a Trinidad que Irene pode ter fugido em uma aventura amorosa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo repreende Irene por não ter contado que ficou presa no elevador com o advogado Basáñez, e ela explica que não queria criar mais problemas, pois foi uma experiência muito desagradável. Basáñez leva um presente para Irene por causa do incidente, ela tenta recusar, mas acaba aceitando com a condição de que ele não a incomode mais.

programme.title: Max Steel
programme.desc: Aos 16 anos de idade, Max McGrath descobre que seu corpo pode gerar a energia mais poderosa do universo, ele deve vincular-se com o único ser capaz de contenê-lo: um extraterrestre tecno-orgânico misterioso chamado Steel. Unidos como o super-herói Max Steel, os dois amigos devem combater uma ameaça alienígena e desvendar os segredos de seu passado.

programme.title: Punhos da Vingança
programme.desc: Em Xangai, um ex-campeão de artes marciais mistas e herdeiro de uma corporação multibilionária jurou nunca mais lutar no ringue depois de matar acidentalmente seu oponente durante sua última luta. Mas quando seu irmão é morto em um torneio de boxe underground, ele não tem escolha a não ser se juntar a Maiwen, uma informante da polícia, para investigar a morte dele - e eles acabam descobrindo uma grande conspiração.

programme.title: Golpe de Risco
programme.desc: Carregado de muita ação, este filme une os maiores ladrões do mundo na tentativa de executar o roubo do século.

programme.title: Ciudad Sitiada
programme.desc: Cuando el payaso de circo Sunny se transforma en un mutante con súperpoderes, se encuentra enfrentado a sus compañeros artistas, quienes fueron alterados en el mismo accidente y ahora están usando sus poderes para causar estragos en la ciudad.

programme.title: Rescate Sangriento
programme.desc: Un ex mafioso ruso que ahora es escritor de novelas policiales debe enfrentarse a su pasado cuando su familia es blanco de la violencia.

programme.title: O Homen Mais Procurado do Mundo
programme.desc: A CIA realiza uma operação conjunta com os SEALs, as forças especiais do exército norte-americano, que estão em pleno Paquistão. O grupo está atrás de pistas que possam levá-los à localização do inimigo número um dos Estados Unidos: Osama Bin Laden, considerado o mentor dos atentados terroristas ocorridos em território americano em 11 de setembro de 2001.

programme.title: O Estrangeiro
programme.desc: A trama gira em torno do empreiteiro militar britânico Lex Walker, que é informado da morte de sua filha. Ao chegar em Los Angeles e descobrir que o corpo não é o dela, ele inicia uma investigação.

programme.title: O Super Lobista
programme.desc: Grande lobista de Washington e seu protegido são pegos quando seus esquemas levam à corrupção e assassinato.

programme.title: Jogo de Xadrez
programme.desc: Mina foi parar atrás das grades após um crime de corrupção. Mas o mandante, o senador Franco, usa sua influência para mantê-la presa e abafar o caso.

programme.title: Acima da Lei
programme.desc: Um ex-mafioso que se tornou empresário e um detetive da polícia devem lutar com um ex-policial sujo que quer levar o assassino de seu filho à justiça.

programme.title: Rastros de um Crime
programme.desc: A vida de Buck Enderly não funcionou como ele planejou. Ele é um faxineiro de meia-idade que mora com sua mãe, de quem ele deve cuidar depois que ela sofre uma lesão debilitante. Quando Buck aceita um novo cliente excêntrico, ele se envolve em um trabalho paralelo para localizar seu filho distante. Com a ajuda de seus vizinhos de vinte e poucos anos, Buck rastreia o jovem perturbado. Mas então, em outra reviravolta do destino, ele se vê cúmplice de um crime violento. Agora Buck deve esconder a verdade de sua família, incluindo seu irmão mais novo - um policial local.

programme.desc: O Delegado Vital e o agente Dani estão à frente de uma operação do Comando de Operações Táticas da Polícia Federal do Brasil para capturar o playboy brasiliense Carlos Beque, envolvido com o tráfico internacional de cocaína.

Em busca de alimento e água, ele se acidenta e perde todos os sentidos. Ela acorda quando já é noite, hora em que as criaturas saem para caçar.

programme.desc: A história do escritor Amos Oz, nascido na Palestina e criado no período pós-guerra por um pai apaixonado por literatura e uma mãe polonesa que fugiu do antissemitismo. Amos Oz buscou um acordo de paz entre Israel e a Palestina.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Passport to Love
programme.desc: Nicole, a successful travel blogger, meets Kade, a marketing rep for a travel publishing company, and they form the beginnings of a relationship while exploring an island destination. They juggle their work traveling around the world while seeing each other again. Both know there’s something special between them, but it will be put to the test when Kade’s competitive boss challenges Kade to thwart Nicole’s business.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: A Toast to Love
programme.desc: A marine archeologist finds wine in a shipwreck. If she hopes to save her research program she must discover the love story behind the wine.

programme.title: A Heart Apart
programme.desc: A quick spreading virus has shut down the world. But when Kenzie and Chase connect in the unlikeliest of ways, they are faced with a perplexing question: how does dating work when you have to stay six feet apart?

programme.title: Same River Twice
programme.desc: Thirteen years ago, four men met on the river. Working as rafting guides, 21 year old Kurt, Stan, Mikey, and Skinner spent their days battling dangerous rapids, and their nights camped out under thousands of stars. It was the perfect summer until a fatal rafting accident claimed the life of their friend, Buck. Years later, the friends return to the river for one last whitewater thrill ride. However, they soon find that things aren't exactly how they remember. Life's experiences have changed the four friends and they're no longer the daredevils they once were. About to face the stretch of the river that took the life of their friend years ago, they must pull together in order to survive a hair-raising run down deadly rapids!

programme.title: Love And The Radio Star
programme.desc: Savannah is hired to rebrand New York's #4 radio show host. But when she accidentally ends up on the air with the host, she becomes part of the show's rebranding herself and discovers if on-air differences or love will have the last word.

programme.title: How to Find Forever
programme.desc: Marley's brilliant at organizing other people's engagements, but unlucky in finding romance herself. When designing her most important proposal yet, the man who could jeopardize it all may be the one who helps find her own love story.

programme.title: Identical Love
programme.desc: After being left at the altar, Dr. Charlotte Hudson needs to escape life at home. She signs up to volunteer at a health clinic in a tropical country. But her plans of escaping are thrown off when she comes across her former fiancé’s twin brother, Seth (a dentist), who is also volunteering with the clinic. As they spend time together, Seth falls in love with Charlotte, but she struggles to let go of seeing her fiancé every time she looks at Seth. The island romance will help her break free from the past and love Seth for who he is.

programme.title: Love In Aruba
programme.desc: At the end of a school year, teacher Amber meets Connor, a single-dad searching for a tutor and nanny for his daughter, Macey. Amber joins Connor overseas in Aruba, watching over Macey while he focuses on work. Connor isn’t used to having a woman in the house again, but Amber’s sincerity and kindness help bridge their awkwardness and bring the family together.

programme.title: Quest For Love
programme.desc: Mackenzie travels to Costa Rica for work. Her best friend Ethan comes along to get romantic inspiration for his action /adventure novel. Mackenzie has loved Ethan for a long time, but he only sees her as a friend--until a tourist named Lucas makes Ethan see Mackenzie in a new light.

programme.title: A Heart Apart
programme.desc: A quick spreading virus has shut down the world. But when Kenzie and Chase connect in the unlikeliest of ways, they are faced with a perplexing question: how does dating work when you have to stay six feet apart?

As they spend time together, Seth falls in love with Charlotte, but she struggles to let go of seeing her fiancé every time she looks at Seth. The island romance will help her break free from the past and love Seth for who he is.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: The Fastest Man on Two Wheels
programme.desc: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing its Dash installed as well as its interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: BarryTiger

Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e explorar com Barry e seus amigos em cada episódio emocionante!

A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.
